layout: Listing-paper sheet with two opening count lines, two upper drawings and a right note, three count equations, a large left sphere and a central coloured tetrahedron, a diagonal right note, four points-base bullets with two separate vertical links and a small raised formula at their left, a smaller sphere and four-holed drawing, a large lower truncated tetrahedron with prose at left and paths at right, a bottom sphere, lighter footer17 and a five-baseline starred note. Eight drawings are reconstructed. The additional oblique connector from above types to the central tetrahedron’s lower vertex is preserved separately from the outward arrow to the diagonal note.
legibility: The main black body is mostly legible, with compressed minims, tall looped ascenders and long descenders. The diagonal note, overwritten digits and compact left abbreviation remain difficult. Right punch holes crowd opposées and path endings; the bottom note nearly meets the scan edge. Pencil curves cross printed diagonal listing bands, so actual curved/retraced traces are separated from the repetitive paper ruling. Coloured outlines remain visible, including red poles, green solid/dotted graph structures and brown broken edges. Whole image and both prepared halves were read once each; all24 saved crop targets were personally viewed. Large PNG displays were replaced only by same-dimension JPEG quality96/subsampling0 view derivatives, without a new crop or resize; original PNG evidence is retained. An earlier output-truncated image was not counted as seen until its successful subsequent display.
witness_comparison: C generally preserves the body wording, abbreviations, products and short parenthetical continuations more closely. Its unresolved marks cover the important local textual uncertainties, but its diagrams often replace broken/retraced or lobed contours by clean ellipses and omit individual marks or the lower rear arrow. Both witnesses miss the heading-to-vertex connector and the closing parenthesis after i.e.; both misread the repeated guingois/guin-gois. H adds a second canceled6 and interprets overlapping count strokes as separately canceled digits, expands supplém. and the uncertain short form, misreads et inv. as voisin, and substantially misreads the starred note. H accurately records several marginal placements and broadly describes the coloured drawings; compatible broad descriptions are not treated as invented handwritten prose. Certainty-only C resolutions remain decisions, not reading-error counts.

notes:
018 opens with the written counts of vertices of stated orders and triangles/hexagons, then records s_0=4+6+4.3=22, s_1=12+4.(uncertain9/8)=48 and s_2=4.7=28 with overlapping numeral strokes. These are transcription readings, not arithmetic verification. The diagonal note attaches a written 2^(uncertain9/4)−1=15 formula to possibilités, des faces choisies and an unresolved final phrase ending vue !. The point list records 3 square structures, 2 tétraédrales structures with an unresolved orientation(s) ending, 6 bi-pantaloniques structures with marginal opposées and a maillot/codiagonale parenthesis, and 6 pantaloniques structures de guingois with quart de tour. The small omega formula is graphically retained with an unidentified raised looped glyph and upper-right J; below, rep(J) is vertically linked to J×omega_J. The left note describes what the drawing shows using an unresolved short form and the source phrases configuration-carré, bien pantalonique and guin-gois. The path list writes the products associated with a–g, preserves inv., supplém., and the unmatched closing marks, then leaves relations followed by three points. The starred note says the two traversal senses give eight types of deformations to visualize from the conforme and combinatoire points of view; it also writes two possible points of view in its final parenthesis. No mathematical definition, proof, correction, or conditional theorem is supplied by this reader. Printed listing bands and punch holes are sheet support, not additional source drawing strokes. The right-hand continuations des faces and opposées are set in their offset positions. Their layout alone is not counted as a reading error against C; M0127 resolves the already favored opposées reading.

Root arithmetic check 148_scan018-CHECK-incidence-arithmetic. The opening vertex groups give 4+6+12=22 and weighted sum 4·6+6·6+12·3=96. The opening face groups give 24+4=28 and side sum 24·3+4·6=96. Half of each incidence sum is 48. The displayed integer expressions evaluate as 4+6+4·3=22 and 4·7=28; 12+4·9=48 whereas 12+4·8=44. The written totals 22,48,28 give 22−48+28=2. These are exact arithmetic comparisons of the stated numbers, with no proof of a geometric identification or of a reconstruction from the drawings. The overwritten factor remains governed by the crop; numerical compatibility supplies no missing stroke. Certificate: work/148018_counts_check.json; script: scripts/check_148018_counts.py.

Root check 148_scan018-CHECK-exponent-candidates evaluates the two retained readings explicitly: 2^4−1=15, whereas 2^9−1=511. The written right-hand side is 15. Thus the graphically preferred 9 reading leaves a numerical discrepancy, recorded here; the closed-loop exponent remains 9|4 in the transcription. Arithmetic supplies no missing angular stroke. See scripts/check_148018_exponents.py and work/148018_exponents_check.json.
